verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only filtered list and read endpoints, such as listing meetings by company domain. These are developer building blocks for fetching many items, not a first-party bulk operation that acts on many items at once. No batch or bulk-action endpoint, UI multi-select action, or bulk MCP tool is documented, so this is adjacent support and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Returns meetings whose associated company matches one of the specified domains.
